user.title: Configurar Eguraldi
user.description:
Enter your **Open Data Euskadi registered email** and the complete contents of **privatekey.pem**.

[Request or download my Open Data Euskadi keys]({api_keys_url})

**No account yet?** We recommend **Sign in with Google** (for example, a Gmail account). Email registration can fail to deliver the activation message. If an account is already pending activation, use a Google account that is not pending. Also check spam.

Download the keys ZIP, open privatekey.pem and copy its contents. The key stays in your Home Assistant.

station.title: Choose a weather station
station.description: Found {station_count} active weather stations. Each option shows how many measurements it provides and which are missing. Tide gauges and stations without weather data are not listed.

confirm.title: Confirm incomplete station
confirm.description:
Station **{station}** provides: {available}.

It does not provide: **{missing}**.

Sensors will only be created for the available measurements. Press Submit to add it anyway.

locality.title: Tu localidad
locality.description: Escribe el municipio. Se consulta Open-Meteo / GeoNames solo con ese nombre para obtener sus coordenadas; tus credenciales no se comparten. La previsión y los avisos serán los de la localidad, aunque cambies de estación.

place.title: Confirma la localidad
place.description: Elige el municipio correcto para evitar confundir localidades con el mismo nombre.

recommendation.title: Estación recomendada para {locality}
recommendation.description:
Recomendamos **{station}**, a **{distance} km** en línea recta. Publica: {available}. No publica: {missing}. Se priorizan cercanía, temperatura, humedad y lluvia. La altitud y el entorno pueden producir diferencias respecto a tu localidad. Puedes aceptar o elegir otra estación cercana.

{origin}

account.title: Add another location
account.description: Reuse an account already saved in HA without entering its key again, or configure another account.

location_source.title: Eguraldi location
location_source.description: Use the location configured in Home Assistant by default. Its municipality is identified locally without sending coordinates to a geocoder. You can also add another locality by name.

{origin}

home_assistant.title: Home Assistant location
home_assistant.description: Uses the location configured in Settings → System → General. You can also select another locality in options.

microclimate.title: Learn your home microclimate
microclimate.description:
Optional, local analysis. Select an outdoor temperature sensor protected from direct sunlight. Hourly means stored in Home Assistant are compared with this location's station. Measurements never leave your HA.

Learning starts when enabled and restarts when the sensor, station or location changes. At least five training days and two complete validation days with sufficient matched hours are required. The estimate is only published if mean absolute error falls by at least 0.2 °C and 10 %, improving on both test days. Official forecasts are unchanged.
